quirks: Documented max page size is 250, but backend silently truncates to 50 items.
Must specify status=active; omitting it includes obsolete 2018 records.
Sorting by quantity requires ascending (asc) or defaults to random order.
Timestamps without explicit ISO offsets default to UTC, leading to date shifts in local reporting.
Missing district_id throws an unhandled 500 error instead of a 400 Bad Request.
